721150101.text: #Hello there, my dear, gallant {F#girl}{M#boy}! I have good news and bad news regarding the Mikage Furnace. Which would you like to hear first?

721150103.text: The good news is that the core's only suffered some minor damage. It is still within my power to fix it.

721150104.text: The bad news, however, is that the Fatui poking around in there don't seem to appreciate this piece of good news.

721150105.text: They very much seem to be searching for a way to get their grubby hands on the Tatarigami core.

721150111.text: But if we let them meddle any further, the Tatarigami's power will get out of control. This entire island will be blown sky-high with us still on it.

721150112.text: However, if we focus solely on the Fatui, the Tatarigami energy built up inside the containment dome will eventually reach its limit all the same...

721150113.text: So we need to deal with both of them at the same time?

721150114.text: Well... Put simply, academically speaking, in an objective sense...

721150115.text: We are facing two separate problems here: the Fatui and the Tatarigami.

721150116.text: But with how the situation is inside the Mikage Furnace, whichever problem we choose to tackle, we're likely to have to face the other in the process.

721150117.text: So, ultimately, the fact of the matter is—

721150119.text: Um, yes, that's correct. We need to deal with both of them at the same time.

721150120.text: But one step at a time. As the Liyue saying goes, "don't rush to eat hot tofu, or you'll burn your tongue."

721150121.text: How come you know Liyue proverbs?

721150122.text: We've been to Liyue before. I'd consider this little gem of wisdom a souvenir from the trip.

721150123.text: I have a lot more of these souvenirs where that one came from. I must confess to having imbibed all of my "souvenirs" from Mondstadt, though... they were really very good.

721150124.text: Let's get back on track. I have a teensy-tiny plan to fix this Mikage Furnace situation, but I will need your help.

721150107.text: The bad news is that the Fatui are still poking around inside the Furnace.

721150108.text: They very much seem to be searching for a way to get their grubby hands on the Tatarigami core.

721150109.text: The good news is that the core hasn't suffered much damage, so I can take care of it myself.

721150110.text: Obviously, the Fatui will be none too pleased to hear that.

721150303.text: Well done, now all we have to do is to let them collect the data.

721150305.text: I was part of the design team for the Mikage Furnace. By placing beacons in these locations, we can gather data on almost all the areas inside.

721150306.text: Hmm, you know, if we set up purifying devices in these locations, our troubles would be over overnight.

721150307.text: If Mr. Flois knew half of what had happened here, he'd go completely ballistic...

721150311.text: Alright, thanks for your help. Please take these as compensation.

721150312.text: Ahem, one other thing... I may possibly, probably, definitely need you to help me retrieve the beacons again at some point over the next few days.

721150313.text: I don't have a Vision, after all, so I can't simply stroll into somewhere with such a high concentration of Tatarigami energy.

721150314.text: Not to mention that those, hmm, rough-and-tough Fatui folks are still there. I honestly think you are the only person on this whole island capable of dealing with them and the furnace at the same time.

721150309.text: You jest! Even if I sold them to you, what would I use then?

721150310.text: Seriously, though, if you ever visit Fontaine, I can put you in touch with someone who will sell them to you at a very fair price.

721150401.text: Hopefully this is as far as the situation escalates... If we go on like this, we'll have a diplomatic incident on our hands and no mistake!

721150503.text: Well done, now all we have to do is let them collect the data.
